title: GDD T-108 — Sequencer: cuotas, anti-repetición y bias anti-frustración (§9.2, §6.4)
description: Extend the existing Sequencer (TASK-005 era) into the GDD §9.2 selector: seeded draw over the active MicrogamePool (v2 definitions from TASK-030) respecting hard constraints — per-7-round session quota (>=1 asymmetric, exactly 1 coop special phase, rest competitive), never the same mechanic two rounds in a row, never the same variant twice per session, plus the §6.4 anti-frustration bias: if a player placed 4th two consecutive rounds, the third round's draw is biased toward a mechanic from that player's best in-session history (bias of SELECTION, never of result). The GDD nesting prohibition applies: one decision -> at most one random draw. The whole selector is a pure function of (seed, history) — fully testable. Applies difficulty ramp D(r) = 1 + 0.06(r−1) metadata to the selected definition (final microgame D=1.5 fixed). Read GDD §9, §6.4 before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Selector is a pure function of (seed, session history): same inputs -> same draw (replay test); no hidden state, no wall clock
Quota test over 1000 seeded 7-round sessions: every session has >=1 asymmetric, exactly 1 coop special, remainder competitive
Anti-repetition: no mechanic twice consecutively and no variant twice per session, verified over the same 1000-session corpus

Anti-frustration bias engages exactly on the two-consecutive-4th-places trigger and provably shifts selection probability toward the player's best-history mechanic without guaranteeing outcome (statistical test)
D(r) ramp attached per round with D_final = 1.5 for the climax microgame
Existing Sequencer consumers keep compiling; tests-first; fast suite green after, no regression

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: [RE-APPLIED after working-tree cleaning lost the original write] FULL-depth fresh-context review (rev-c035) of the CLOUD-authored TASK-035 (branch claude/gdd-hito1-cloud, commits 11d3bfc test -> 4bd442c feat), evidence pinned at 4bd442c: APPROVE-WITH-NITS on its own tree — 0 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM, 3 LOW. Suite 482/482 firsthand (471 base + 11 new); red reproduced at 11d3bfc (CS0234/CS0246 confined to the new Sequencer.V2 types); two-commit discipline + tdd tier honored. MEDIUM-1 (corpus sensor weaker than documented): (a) PlaySession rotation rot=(seed+round)&3 shifts the 4th-place seat EVERY round, so the two-consecutive-4ths bias trigger NEVER fires in the 1000-session corpus (doc comment claiming otherwise is provably false) — bias-vs-constraint interaction rests solely on the separate 200-seed test; (b) the 'remainder competitive' assert is a tautology; (c) corpus asserts the coop window (rounds 3/4) but never the asym window (5/6) nor asym==exactly 1 (GDD 7.2 '1 por sesión' vs AC '>=1' — GDD-vs-test gap). Fix: rotation period 2; Assert asym==1 + asym-round-in-{5,6}. LOW-1 hidden seed coupling (trigger test silently encodes CoopRound(7)!=4; use competitive-only pool). LOW-2 RoundRecord aliases the caller's places array (no defensive copy) — replay-purity hazard. LOW-3 statistical margin ~2 sigma; competitive-only pool doubles it. POSITIVE: AC1 purity audited; AC2/AC3 corpus = 1000 distinct seeds, EVERY session asserted per-round incl. climax; AC4 statistical test real (matched-seed biased-vs-unbiased over 2000 trials, threshold + <0.95 ceiling; off-by-one trigger case covered; bias post-filter selection-weight only, provably cannot override anti-repetition); AC5 D(r)=1+0.06(r-1), D_final=1.5 GDD-verbatim; AC6 only csproj touched, v1 SequencerDirector untouched. GDD cross-checks firsthand: 9.2, 7.1/7.2 windows, 6.4 trigger, nesting prohibition P3 satisfied; v1 SequencerDirector confirmed to contain a P3-violating re-roll loop (SequencerDirector.cs:117-122) validating the V2-successor approach — BUT GDD 9.2 says 'código existente, se extiende': coexistence defensible ONLY if T-107 (TASK-034) retires v1 (note appended there). BiasWeight=3 honestly [ASSUMED]. GDD tension recorded: 6.4 'fuerza en el sorteo' vs its own 'bias suave' parenthetical; implementation follows the AC. INTEGRATION (verified vs local master 45c6259): zero couplings to the unmergeable cloud-024; deps only TASK-030 types + SeededRandom.NextInt (PCG32-preserved API); csproj +2 hunk context byte-identical local-vs-cloud; new paths collide with nothing; expected conflicts ONLY tasks/*.json. INTEGRATION EXECUTED: picks landed on master as 3416adc (test) / bb2abcb (feat); fix round pending; rev-c035 re-verifies.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: [RE-APPLIED] SCOPE ADDITION for the integration fix round (from rev-c044's TASK-044 review + the cloud dev's own note 9): the selector currently mixes seeds with its own Combine() helper; TASK-044 introduces the canonical GDD-13 stream derivation Derive(sessionSeed, round, RngStream.*). Migrate the selector's seed mixing to the Derive idiom AS PART OF this ticket's integration fix round — it shifts the 1000-session corpus streams, and the fix round is already recalibrating that corpus for the rotation-period change (rev-c035 MEDIUM-1), so doing both at once avoids a second corpus churn. Two derivation idioms must NOT coexist after integration.

comments.author: developer
comments.body: INTEGRATION + FIX ROUND complete on master (dev-t101): cherry-picks 3416adc (test) / bb2abcb (feat), fix round 1d84408 (test, red) -> 563922f (fix). Suite at Phase B end: 495 green, zero local regressions. Fix round: rotation period 2 (round/2) — confirmed the OLD formula genuinely could never fire the bias trigger (adjacent rounds never shared a rotation), not cosmetic; asym==Exactly(1) + round-in-{5,6} asserts (mirrors coop pattern); CompetitiveOnlyPool() for the two trigger-exactness tests; RoundRecord clones its places array (genuine red against the aliasing bug). Combine() -> SeededRandom.Derive(sessionSeed, roundNumber, RngStream.Draws) migration done in the same pair; sentinel round-numbers (-1, -2) for the two schedule decisions so they cannot collide with real per-round draws. All tightened assertions incl. the 1000-seed corpus passed on the FIRST post-migration run — no recalibration needed (corpus asserts invariants, not stream-specific values). Awaiting rev-c035 re-verify.
